name: Two-sided quote compression continuation
hypothesis: Buy positive momentum after matched-size buy/sell friction compresses for multiple observations with stable external pricing.
spec: Setup: Reduced round-trip friction may precede broader participation. Entry: Buy positive momentum after matched-size buy/sell friction compresses for multiple observations with stable external pricing. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit if friction re-expands or momentum reverses. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs executable DEX pool depth and quote history (not connected)
